messages:
incident-bot: [P2] Ingress response fanout loop detected in us-east1. Observed increased downstream fanout to replica set 'proxy-repl-a' causing ~8% 5xx for hosted endpoints and sporadic streaming disconnects. Customers impacted: small subset of hosted reads and long-lived streams. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2471254321 — runbook: https://go/playbooks/ingress-fanout-loop. Pager: eng-oncall.
Sam: Copy. I can see duplicate downstream requests in the access logs. Looks like the proxy re-sending in a tight loop for some responses.
Marie: Starting canary rollout of circuit-breaker feature flag (cb-2026-03-23-01) to us-east1 (10%). Will monitor errorrate and tail latency.
Dinesh: Added a temporary egress throttle on ingress-proxy to cap downstream fanout while cb canary ramps. Applied via: `kubectl apply -f /ops/throttles/fanout-ctrl.yaml -n ingress`
Lindsey: Customer impact summary for CS: intermittent 5xx and disconnects for long polling / streaming endpoints. Roughly 2-3% of requests in the region. Preparing a short customer note for affected tenants.
Sam: Canary looks good after 3m. 5xx dropped from ~8% to ~0.9%. Increasing rollout to 50%.
incident-bot: Mitigations in flight: circuit-breaker canary -> 50% rollout, egress throttle rule active. Dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/ingress/fanout-loop. Alert thresholds adjusted to avoid noisy spam.
Dinesh: Quick log snippet showing duplicate fanout header:
```
2026-03-23T14:21:02Z proxy-repl-a request_id=abc123 upstream="10.2.1.5" fanout_count=4 x-agg-id="agg-9999" x-agg-id="agg-9999"
```
Root cause suspected: malformed aggregator header causing proxy to treat request as multi-destination. Working on a header-sanitization patch.
Sam: Keep throttle + cb in place while we verify. Rollback plan: if 5xx > 2% for 5m after the 100% rollout, revert cb and remove throttle; rollback steps rehearsed.
Lindsey: CS will send targeted notices. Ops to prepare customer-facing timeline once we have full remediation ETA.
Marie: Rolling cb to 100% now. Will hold and observe for 10m before removing throttle.
Dinesh: Confirm no data loss detected. Logs indicate duplicate fanout originated from an upstream aggregator version mismatch — patch + compatibility guard being prepared.
incident-bot: Current status: mitigated — service recovery in progress. Postmortem owner: @Dinesh. Action items: RCA + header-sanitization + automated loop-detection alert + add unit for aggregator header parsing. Interim notes: https://go/incident/2471254321-notes. Will update when RCA timeline available. :white_check_mark:
